title: Abacco Internal CRM Suite
cardDescription: Internal Lead, Sales and Domain Management CRMs with role-based access and real-time WebSocket notifications.
overview: A suite of internal CRMs used at Abacco Technology: Lead CRM for tracking and assigning leads, Sales CRM for pipeline and reporting, and Domain CRM for domain portfolios and renewals.
problem: Leads, sales follow-ups and domain renewals were tracked manually, making it easy to miss follow-ups and expiry dates.
solution: Three connected internal CRMs with role-based access, so each team member sees what's relevant to them, plus real-time notifications over WebSockets.
result: Teams track leads, sales and domain renewals in one place and get notified instantly about new leads and status changes.

challenges.challenge: Users must only see records they're allowed to.
challenges.solution: Applied role-based access checks on both API routes and UI views.
